resources.string: "Connect in riding mode to read the device settings."
"Up to 48 UTF-8 bytes. Shown on the device after saving."
"To edit, keep IGN ON and speed at or below 3 km/h for 5 seconds."
"Run this action? Bluetooth actions may disconnect the phone. Reconnect to check the actual result."
"\nPositive values raise the UART level index. Noodoe display brightness stays unchanged."
"Enter a whole number within the range."
"Use the new dashboard value as the baseline?"

"If NOODOE INSTALLER is visible, installation is still running.

Tap below once CFW UPDATE appears with Starting Bluetooth, Waiting for your phone, or Checking the new version. Bluetooth and healthy operation are checked next.

The 180-second rollback deadline starts at device boot and keeps running while you wait here."
"New CFW screen is visible · check connection"
"Sync music, notifications and GPS trails. Location is sent only while ignition is ON."
"Start recording manually to save rides on the phone. Music, notifications, GPS and device trip/service totals work without recording. Disconnected intervals remain unknown."
"Stop the riding link before replacing photos or updating firmware. Photos are center-cropped to a square."
"Without a phone connection, choose Back to stock in Bootstrap, release O, then hold O again for 2 seconds. No extra IGN operation is needed."
"Not needed for normal installation. Bootstrap reads 128 MiB twice to preserve and compare it. This takes time and needs over 300 MiB free on the phone. Keep permanent power connected."
"Stop the riding link first. After diagnostics, choose Back to stock on Noodoe and hold O for 2 seconds. Settings and photos stay. A supported Gate is required."
"Have you reviewed the failed update and rollback? The evidence stays; only your acknowledgement is saved."
"Failed initial file creation is not retried automatically. From running CFW, enter independent Gate with key OFF → hold O about 1 second → key ON while holding O → hold 2 more seconds."
"Allow notification access first. Choose from apps with current notifications."
"Gate restores only the stock APP. CFW settings, photos, records and FAT stay intact."

"The erase-only firmware is sent first. On Noodoe, use UP/DOWN to select Erase CFW data, release O and hold it again for 2 seconds. It erases CFW file contents and frees their space. Stock photos, factory data and phone logs stay. Physical power-cut testing of this route is not yet complete."
"Features without permission stay off. You can enable them in Permissions and setup."
"Device association is complete. Check the auto-connect permission."
"Waiting to identify the device after installation."
"Send the installer to stock firmware? Device/package compatibility is checked first. Then follow the key instructions on Noodoe."
"Send the new CFW? Settings and CFW photos reset after healthy boot confirmation. A failed trial rolls back to the previous state."
"Return to stock and keep CFW data? Older recovery layouts can migrate through stock and Bootstrap from the latest ZIP. Devices supporting normal CFW updates do not need this route."
"No saved rides yet. Connect in riding mode and tap Start ride recording."
"Could not open ride history. Check phone storage."

"Reset the app connection and current operation selection. Device firmware, settings, existing logs and recovery evidence are not deleted.\n\nNo device ABORT command is sent. Operations with unknown results are queried first after reconnecting."
"Check location-service permission. The riding link stays connected."
"This is the last display from a previous operation. Nothing resumed automatically. Check device status and the journal.\n\n"
"Phone recording stopped. Music, notifications and GPS stay connected."
"Could not save the stopped-link state. Check phone storage."
"Riding link stopped manually. You can update now."
"Choose a Noodoe to install. Pair it in Android settings first."
"Could not export ride history. Check the destination."

"Android blocked the background service. Open the app and check permissions."
"Riding link stays active. For automatic GPS, allow location all the time or open the app."
"Check the update result first. Automatic riding link stays off until then."

"Your existing dialer and headset stay. Answer/end needs companion association and Android 12+. If Android restricts call-history access, the list shows Permission Denied!."
"Automatic background GPS · allow location all the time"

"Start the riding link with the app open; location continues with the screen off while IGN is ON. Key OFF or disconnection stops collection. For automatic background reconnect, allow location all the time. On Galaxy, also check App info → Battery → Unrestricted. Turn off power saving if it blocks screen-off GPS. Installation does not require location permission."

"A stopped installation is not resent from scratch. Check device → last operation → resume. Logs and recovery evidence remain preserved."
"You can select the latest ZIP for older CFW. Update or resume below without downgrading the phone app."
